async def act(page):
    # Fill in the username 'Vinta' in the 'Select members to invite' textbox
    invite_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Select members to invite")
    await invite_textbox.fill("Vinta")
    # Wait for the dropdown to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Click the option 'Vinta Chen @vinta' from the dropdown
    vinta_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="Vinta Chen @vinta")
    await vinta_option.click()
    # Wait for the 'Add to project' button to become enabled
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click the 'Add to project' button to send the invitation
    add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add to project")
    await add_button.click()
